name: Travel Day Optimizer
description: Creates minute-by-minute travel day schedules from departure to arrival, covering airport timelines, transit connections, check-in sequences, and contingency buffers. Produces a complete travel day checklist with time stamps, action items, and what-if scenarios for delays. Use when the user asks about organizing a travel day, planning airport timing, creating a departure-to-arrival schedule, or managing tight connections. Do NOT use for multi-day trip itineraries (use trip-itinerary-builder), packing guidance (use packing-list-builder), or airport navigation (use airport-navigation-guide).
